promise.text: Four steps that fix a dry brisket.

meta.hypothesis: Loud poster covers earn more sends in food audiences.

caption:
Dry brisket is rarely the cut's fault.

It usually comes down to pulling it too early or slicing it too soon. Send this to whoever runs your smoker.

#Brisket #BBQ

slides.headline: Stop slicing it hot.
slides.alt: Red poster cover with the condensed headline Stop slicing it hot above three cards.
slides.visual_prompt: Three overlapping cards in yellow and cream. Composed by the engine.

slides.headline: Three usual suspects.
slides.alt: Three cells listing the usual causes of dry brisket: pulled early, rested too little, sliced with the grain.
slides.visual_prompt: Bento cells in the brand palette.

slides.headline: Slow down at the end.
slides.alt: Three numbered steps: probe until soft, rest wrapped and warm, slice across the grain.

slides.headline: Minimum rest.
slides.alt: Sand slide with a large value of one hour as the minimum rest, marked as a fictional house rule.

slides.headline: Patience is the rub.
slides.body: Plan the rest into your timing.
slides.alt: Red closing slide asking the reader to plan the rest and send the post to their pitmaster.
slides.visual_prompt: Loud red close with one yellow action panel.
